analytic_definition.uniform_joint_probability: 1/6 each; exact pV=1/6 and radius2 pV=3/6, so not a neutral binary-visible prior
analytic_definition.VV: Exact visible is only jointVV: mask1 means positive, noVVbit means confirmed visible-negative, VV plus other states means exact visibility unknown.
analytic_definition.UNKNOWN: Class E/O ambiguity can still certify visible-negative; all63 is uninformative and has exactly0 loss/gradient. UNKNOWN is not uniformly identical to all63.
analytic_definition.pressure: For informative cells, VV included => negative derivative/raiseVV under descent; VV excluded => positive derivative/lowerVV. Direction of independent-logit derivative is not a learned parameter gradient.

normalization_review.global_population_target_weights_not_uni: Target inclusion probability depends on eligible center count m_t:1-(1-m_t/pool)^n. Unique-target reduction is per sampled minibatch, not equal over all source population targets.

limitations: This is structural label/sampler analysis. It does not read trained logits or compute actual parameter gradients.

Actual gradients depend on current logits, input features, shared parameters and coupling between global/dense branches. Uniform aggregate direction cannot establish a branch or private-transfer cause.
CONTROLLED_ONLY replay uses the identical first3 source blocks in the sealed PLUS label table, preserving row indices; PALLOX is appended in merge candidate order.
No observed-score NLL decomposition is performed; another agent owns that saved-score analysis.
